output.content: The current data ingestion process is entirely manual. {data_dave} confirmed that there is no automated pipeline in place. All data is collected, cleaned, and prepared for modeling by hand. This approach introduces variability and potential errors into the dataset. The team has not yet implemented any tools or scripts to streamline this workflow. The manual process is time-consuming and relies heavily on individual expertise to ensure data quality.
output.reclassify_reason: This statement provides an objective description of the current data ingestion process without expressing any wishes, refusals, or acceptances.
